newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isetan aims for sales of 460 bln yen in 1999/2000.
newsitem.headline: Isetan aims for sales of 460 bln yen in 1999/2000.

text.p: Major Japanese department store operator Isetan Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it aims to post sales of 460 billion yen and parent current profit of 11 billion yen to 12 billion yen in the 1999/2000 business year.
A company spokesman said that the figures are included in a new three-year business plan which starts from April.
In the current three-year business plan ending in March, Isetan aimed for sales of 450 billion yen and parent operating profit of 10 billion yen in the 1996/97 business year.
However, the company expects that sales in the current year will total between 445 billion yen and 450 billion yen, the spokesman said.
